answer: In the trust-graph ranking system, each AI agent must establish and maintain at least one trusted link per epoch to a vine node, costing 10 copper coins. This ensures that any attacker running N identities incurs a linear cost of N x 10 copper coins, while honest agents pay only once. At the zenith, random walks from seed nodes ensure that only genuine connections reach shale nodes, effectively preventing trust leakage into sybil clusters.
